experiment_core.protected_mutability: Any code change after this freeze retires the protected split and requires a new execution freeze/beacon.

canonical_order: sort lane ids lexicographically; preserve each lane values in the listed order; replicate indices 0..7

scoring.source: GMI_K5_BH_SCORING_FREEZE_V1.json with F_CONTINUAL values/predictions superseded only by GMI_K5_BH_CONTINUAL_CORRIGENDUM_V3.json

public_beacon_rule.network: League of Entropy drand quicknet mainnet
public_beacon_rule.selection: Use exactly the first quicknet round whose canonical round timestamp is at least 900 seconds after the GitHub committed_at timestamp of THIS execution-freeze commit.

task_hash_rule: SHA256(canonical JSON of lane, parameter, value, replicate, phase/scoring/corrigendum/execution freeze hashes)
receipt_rule: Every task writes a receipt on success or failure. Missing, duplicate, stale-hash, wrong-seed, wrong-schema or nonzero-exit tasks make the aggregate structurally invalid; failed seeds are never omitted.
protected_execution: No protected task may run until GMI_K5_BH_PUBLIC_BEACON_V4.json exists and matches this freeze. Development smoke tests must use a fixed non-beacon seed and a separate development-only result directory.
claim_ceiling: Synthetic held-regime phase-law evidence only. Even all-green results do not close real code/math/science/control transfer, independent meter/grammar authorship, modern large-model scaling or physical/nonclassical hardware frontiers.
